notes.subject: עליו / לנקבציו
notes.rationale: Tupela ridin: 'long em' (ol narapela man i go long Yisrael) o 'long ol' (ol i kolektime pinis) — KJV 'to him', JPS 'to him besides his own that are gathered'.

notes.subject: קבץ / נקבציו
notes.rationale: Wanpela as קבץ i kamap tupela taim — pasin bilong kolektim i rit pak; raitim 'kolektime' tupela taim long Tok Pisin.

translation: Tok bilong Adonai Yahwe, em i kolektime ol man bilong Yisrael ol i paitim i go ausait: bihain bai mi kolektime ol man i go long ⟨em⟩, wantaim ol man bilong ⟨em⟩ ol i kolektime pinis.

tokens.gloss: ol man ol i paitim i go ausait
wantaim ol man bilong ⟨em⟩ ol i kolektime pinis
